inherited_insufficient: scripts/run_interface_mutations.py strips proof tails only when module.startswith('DefiKernel.Interface.'); Typed/Composition computational mutations retain old proof terms and fail to compile. Compilation failure is blocked, not semantic detection.
mechanism: Certificates driver inlines the local DefiKernel closure then strips every `-- BEGIN PROOFS` suffix in DefiKernel.Certificates.*, DefiKernel.Typed.*, and DefiKernel.Composition.* modules in that closure. Mathlib/Lean imports remain external. Guard: no runtime declaration tokens after the marker. Namespace end restored. Intact projected sibling (same strip, no needle replacement) must reproduce independent expected observations.
preserved_from_interface_runner: positive_checks is that mutant's protected check only
outer invocation record because child logs write after subprocess.run returns
preservation_conditional: If a later Certificates.Examples imports Composition.Examples, add DefiKernel.Composition.Preservation to the local closure and to Composition audit prefix. This increment copies literals instead.

classification_rules.allowlist_match: module+name+kind+sort+source path+input_sha256; names are the four listed declarations only
classification_rules.proof_only: allowlisted Prop inductive/def after the marker are logical declarations, not runtime discard
classification_rules.runtime_discard_forbidden: any other def/abbrev/structure/inductive after the marker, or an allowlisted name whose source hash changed, is unrecognized changed source and blocks the run
classification_rules.computational_before_marker: runtime declarations remain before the marker; discarding them is forbidden
classification_rules.dependencies_versus_consumers: existing_9_targets list mutated modules; consumers_in_closure are importers, not mutation sites

no_runtime_discard: each stripped module is checked for def/abbrev/structure/inductive after the marker except the four proof-only allowlisted Prop declarations; forbidden tokens block the run
intact_projected_sibling: control variant with projection and no replacement must still satisfy F25/F27/F08/F15/F21/F23/F24/F40/F47/F50 independent observations used as protected checks. The allowlist makes that sibling constructible: the guard does not treat StepSound/ReceiptAuthorized/TraceSound/RefusalSound as discarded runtime.
